From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + pilot kickoff: proposed windows & prompt agenda

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap from our side: you’re prioritizing faster triage of model drift in your content moderation pipeline and want a short pilot that proves reduction in false positives while keeping latency under 250ms for interactive moderation tooling. Key constraints you mentioned: no customer PII in logs for the pilot, and a compliance review before we share any in-house telemetry.

Proposed next step: a 60–75 minute pilot kickoff that covers a technical deep-dive, success criteria alignment, and a short workshop to agree on a prompt set and evaluation pack. Rough agenda and prework below. Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team (all in PT):

- Tue Sep 7 — 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed Sep 8 — 13:00–14:15 PT
- Thu Sep 9 — 09:00–10:15 PT

Draft agenda (we’ll refine once we lock a slot):
- 5m / Intros & goals
- 15m / Architecture & data flow for the pilot (Marissa will lead)
- 20m / Success criteria & evaluation metrics (pass/fail thresholds)
- 20m / Prompt set workshop and sample inputs
- 15m / Compliance/security asks + next steps

Prework for your team (short):
- Share a representative sample of anonymized examples for the prompt workshop (10–20 items)
- Confirm point of contact for security/compliance (name + email)
- Complete the short Mutual Action Plan template (attached) so we can lock milestones and deliverables

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan.docx, Pilot_Success_Criteria.xlsx (stubs)

If none of the windows fit, propose 1–2 alternatives and I’ll coordinate with Marissa to adapt.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference.com

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first platform for high-performance LLM inference
